$schema_note: VENUE-AUTO-ONBOARDING-01 — governed, data-driven Source -> canonical Venue mappings, consumed by ingestion/venue-onboarding/data-driven-resolver.mjs and dispatched into ingestion/venue/resolver.mjs's resolveObservation(). Every entry retains: source_id, source_key_type (matching ingestion/venue-onboarding/candidates.mjs's CANDIDATE_KEY_TYPES), source_key (the exact, normalised key — see candidates.mjs's deriveCandidateKey), venue_id, evidence, and created/retrieved provenance. Adding a new venue mapping is a DATA change here, never a code change in ingestion/venue/resolver.mjs. Existing historical hardcoded mappings already in ingestion/venue/resolver.mjs (AgendaLX Capitólio/Graça/BOTA, Hot Clube Capitólio, the Capitólio venue-page location_text table, BOTA/Odivelas/fixed-venue-source tables) are deliberately left untouched by this package — they are not migrated here, per this task's explicit 'unnecessary regression risk' guidance. This file starts empty; every entry present after a real run was appended by `npm run onboard:venues` (ingestion/venue-onboarding/run.mjs), never hand-authored, from the bounded, evidence-gated decisions in venues/candidate-research.json.

evidence.note: Official Casa Capitão website (Beato, Lisboa cultural space — concerts, exhibitions, artistic residencies) states its own address: 'Rua do Grilo, 119, Beato Innovation District'. No postal code was found on the fetched page within this task's bounded search, so none is fabricated here; secondary (non-first-party) sources disagree on the exact postcode digits (1950-142/144/146 variously reported), which is exactly why this project does not treat them as address authority.

The operator's own top-level agenda page exposes three distinct agenda tabs: a general listing, /agenda/teatro-variedades/, and /agenda/capitolio/ — confirming these are two separately-programmed buildings sharing one operator, not one undifferentiated feed. This source's own collector (ingestion/lisbon-porto/run.mjs's collectCapitolio()) fetches ONLY /agenda/capitolio/.

Confirms both Teatro Variedades and Cineteatro Capitólio share the one Parque Mayer complex address already evidenced in venues/lisbon.json for the canonical venue, with separate per-venue contact emails/phones.
